verdict.rationale: First-party webhook docs say developers can configure endpoints to be notified when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states, as an alternative to polling for status updates. This confirms parses run as jobs with both status polling and completion webhooks (docs-6, docs-59, docs-1). The evidence only implies the polling and async-submission side, and the getting-started snippet shows a blocking-style parse() call. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the async job submit and status-polling endpoints, webhook payload/retry/signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration that pipelines run non-blocking.
